Name: (CP) Copia's Valley - A custom NPC mod (1.6 Compatible)
Author: HystericMuse
Description:
[center][i][size=3]This is not a tale of death, but of new life.
[/size]
The most highly esteemed Papa Emeritus IV is currently enjoying some R&R in the beautiful Pelican Town. Away from the Ministry and the ever-looming shadow of an uncertain future, Copia feels more and more like he could take up a quieter life after retiring from his papal duties. Befriend the Dark Lord’s favourite child and take a deeper look at a (slightly) more relaxed Papa - Your futures could well be intertwined.

[/i]Welcome to Copia's Valley, a Stardew 1.6 mod which places the current frontman of the Swedish band Ghost into the quaint life of Pelican Town. Copia is a standalone NPC which does not replace any of the vanilla NPCs, he also has his own custom house placed on the town map, as shown in screenshot images of this mod page. In addition to this, Copia has his [b]own custom heart events[/b] and a narrative which emerges between them, as well as completely [b]uniquely written dialogue[/b] for [b]before and after marriage[/b] with the NPC.[/center]
[center]Copia's outfit and portrait sprites [b]change dependent on season[/b], and he has animation frames unique to him as well. I've thrown in quite a few references to Ghost and their webisode 'Chapters' which fans of the band should recognise and enjoy!

There's minimal amounts of swearing in this mod. Nothing too crazy.
I also wanted to just add that sometimes the 'speech' bubble won't appear when hovering over Copia - try clicking on him anyway, he might just have something to say.


This mod [b]will [/b]require[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/] SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] to run.

Feel free to contact me if you have any issues, or to report any bugs found that I can fix!﻿﻿

[i]Copia should be compatible with any mod that doesn't change the layout of the town map in any way. I'll be working to confirm if he works with Stardew Valley Extended - And will update this section accordingly.[/i]

Special thanks to my friend, @raven.ovs (Insta) for helping me with Italian translations in the English version of the mod. 

If you'd like to support to support my work I accept tips on [url=https://ko-fi.com/hystericmuse]Ko-Fi[/url] or I also now have a [url=https://patreon.com/eloisebuttery?utm_medium=unknown&utm_source=join_link&utm_campaign=creatorshare_creator&utm_content=copyLink]Patreon[/url]﻿﻿ for behind the scenes content and more!﻿
[b][i][size=4]
INSTALLING
[/size][/i][/b]Please make sure you have both SMAPI and Content Patcher installed, as these two dependencies are crucial for the mod to work. Once SMAPI is activated and Content Patcher is in the appropriate directory, simply extract my file and drag and drop '[CP]Copia'sValley' into your mod folder.

To be specific, it should be in this location:

(steam/steamapps/common/StardewValley/Mods)[/center][b]

[center][size=4][b][i][u]SCHEDULING[/u][/i][/b][/size][/center][center]﻿
Copia's schedule changes [b]dependent on season[/b]. Usually, Copia is either in [b]town[/b] or in [b]his home[/b] - He's finding it a little hard to adjust to living among so many others. He does visit the [b]Graveyard[/b] in town at night, the [b]Stardrop Saloon[/b] and occasionally the [b]Beach[/b].[/center][color=#b6d7a8][size=4][b][i]Spring
[/i][/b][/size][/color][size=2][spoiler]6:00AM - 9:00AM: In his house.
9:00AM - 6:00PM: Can be found in various areas around town. Near a lamp post or just outside the Stardrop Saloon.
6:00PM - 7:00PM: The graveyard. I wonder what he's doing.
7:00PM Onward: In his house.[/spoiler][/size]

[color=#ffe599][size=4][b][i]Summer:
[/i][/b][/size][/color][size=2][spoiler]6:00AM - 7:00AM: In his house. 
7:00AM - 10:00AM: Near the water fountain in town, with his rats.
10:00AM - 12:30PM: On the beach.
12:30PM - 4:00PM: The Stardrop Saloon. 
4:00PM - 6:00PM: A tree near the blacksmith's.
6:00PM Onward: In his house.[/spoiler][/size]

[size=4][color=#f9cb9c]Fall: 
[/color][/size][size=2][spoiler]6:00AM - 10:00AM: In his house.
10:00AM - 12:00PM: In town, near the Stardrop Saloon waiting for it to open.
12:00PM - 4:00PM: In the Stardrop Saloon.
4:00PM - 6:00PM: In his house. 
6:00PM - 10:00PM: The graveyard. 
10:00PM Onward: In his house.[/spoiler]
[/size]
[b][i][color=#6fa8dc][size=4]Winter:
[/size][/color][/i][/b][size=2][spoiler]6:00AM - 8:00AM: In his house. 
8:00AM - 10:00AM: Just outside Harvey's Clinic in town.
10:00AM - 12:00PM: The bus stop. 
12:00PM - 3:30PM: The Stardrop Saloon.
3:30PM - 5:00PM: Near the water fountain in town.
5:00PM onward: In his house.[/spoiler]

[i][b][spoiler]When raining, Copia will remain inside his house.[/spoiler][/b][/i]
